title: Magnetic investigation in di- and tetranuclear lanthanide complexes

synthesis.procedure: A mixture of Dy(OTs)3·9H2O (0.2 mmol) and ligand H2L (0.2 mmol) in 8 mL of acetonitrile was heated at 80 °C for 1 h. After cooling to room temperature, the yellow solution was filtered and allowed to evaporate slowly. Yellow crystals of Dy2 suitable for X-ray diffraction were obtained after 4 days.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution heating then filtration and slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered yellow solution slowly evaporated to give yellow crystals

properties.summary: Dy2 is a zero-field SMM with intramolecular ferromagnetic Dy···Dy coupling. χMT at 300 K is 28.02 cm3 K mol−1 (two free DyIII expected 28.34), decreases to 25.59 cm3 K mol−1 at 20 K, then rises to 33.93 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K. Frequency-dependent ac χ″ peaks appear under zero dc field; Arrhenius fit of high-T relaxation times gives Ueff = 14.3 K. Full-range fit with fixed Ueff gives τQTM = 7.39×10−4 s, C = 31.38 s−1 K−n, n = 3, τ0 = 2.04×10−5 s. Calculated magnetic axes of Dy1 and Dy2 intersect at 22.6°.

material_class.structural_family: planar windmill Dy4 core with μ4-OH and μ2-O hydrazone bridges

synthesis.procedure: A mixture of Dy(ClO4)3·6H2O (0.1 mmol) and ligand H2L (0.1 mmol) in 15 mL of methanol/dichloromethane (v:v = 1:2) was stirred for 5 min, then triethylamine (0.2 mmol) was added. After stirring for 1 h, the yellow solution was filtered and the filtrate was allowed to evaporate slowly. Yellow crystals of Dy4 suitable for X-ray diffraction were obtained after 5 days.
synthesis.time: stirred 5 min then 1 h after NEt3; crystals after 5 days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution stirring then filtration and slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered yellow solution slowly evaporated to give yellow crystals

properties.summary: Dy4 has a diamagnetic ground state from centripetal/antiparallel arrangement of DyIII magnetic axes rather than SMT toroidal moments. χMT is 55.27 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K (four free DyIII expected 56.68) and drops sharply below 30 K to 12.67 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K. dM/dH vs H at 1.9 K has a minimum at zero field. No χ″ under zero dc field; weak field-induced slow relaxation without χ″ maxima under 1500 Oe, ascribed to QTM from highly distorted C2v geometry (CShM 13.92).
